# Noto Sans Thai

Self-hosted variable font (weights 100–900), distributed under the SIL Open Font License in `NotoSansThai-OFL.txt`.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosansthai

CSS limits the face to Thai, joining controls and the dotted-circle glyph. English display and monospace typography retain the existing dashboard design.
